title: siteproof Fix
description: One change addressing one or more Findings, in exactly one Area. One Fix is one commit. Based on claude-seo-ai's finding.schema.json (MIT), extended with ranking and proof fields. Enforced at runtime by scripts/lib/plan.mjs validateFix().

key.description: Stable Fix key <area>:<slug>. Same problem → same key on every audit; used for issue dedup, Plan↔issue matching and stale-issue closing.

area.description: Picked by the Fix's primary intent.

title.description: What changes, in a few words.

why.description: Evidence shown in the Plan, e.g. 'LCP −2.1s' or '6 routes missing titles'. Not used in scoring.

impact.description: Shared 1–5 scale with a per-Area rubric (see agents/planner.md).

effort.description: S=1, M=2, L=3 in the score.

risk.description: Chance the change breaks something or visibly changes the page.

targetMetric.description: Speed Fixes only: the one metric its Proof is judged on.

findingIds.description: Findings (from the auditors) this Fix addresses.

checkIds.description: SEO/GEO: check IDs that must flip fail → pass to prove the Fix (e.g. seo.title, geo.llms-txt).

content.description: Content rewrite: listed as a suggestion and filed as a `content` issue, never applied.

detail.description: Instructions for the fixer: files, routes, exact change, Next.js convention to use.

issue.description: Set by `ship.mjs sync` when an open siteproof issue has this key.
